prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-psilon-homeworld.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
5 · Psilon — Mentar — pale gold / cream
Game role: the scholars. Strengths: superior researchers (×1.5 output, cheaper fields, a wider tech tree). Weakness: no military or production edge — the galaxy would rather out-shoot them.
Body & dress: hairless, enormous smooth cranium with fine vein tracery, small mouth/nose, large dark calm eyes, a small jewel set in the forehead (a mark of scholarly rank). Simple high-collared scholar's robes in cream and bronze, thin gold edging, small data-jewel pendants. Elegant, understated.
Surroundings: vast quiet libraries and laboratories: white-gold stone and bronze lattice, floating holographic star-charts and equations, long shelves of data crystals, still pools reflecting light; clean but intensely used.
Personality: serene, curious, faintly condescending, unsettlingly analytical. Moods: absorbed calm → polite impatience → pained disappointment.
Hooks: unsolved-problem walls (equations on glass), a half-built orrery, tea-like ritual drinks.
Asset purpose: Homeworld orbital view. Photorealistic planetary orbital view using the race homeworld description. Original believable space infrastructure reflecting culture. No people. No giant decorative emblems. Astronomical camera rather than shallow portrait focus.
Composition: Planet occupies lower-left half; right 35% and top 20% remain predominantly dark space, sparse stars only, for overlays. Keep focal surface features crop-safe. Small orbital stations and ships close to the limb; no large ships on right.
World: Mentar: pale gold-white planet with elegant lattice orbital observatories.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
